collisions.finding: W13-10 and W12-100 both descend from W12-99 but neither is ancestor of the other.
collisions.decision: Start from W12-100 and semantically recover W13-10.

collisions.finding: W13-10 director files were older than W12-100 convergence director truth.
collisions.decision: Preserved W12-100 director records and represented W13-10 recovery in ops/codex-runs/W13-100 and imported W13-10 run artifacts.

collisions.finding: W12-100 added provider-capable outbox transport while W13-10 added runtime/provider authorization and budget controls.
collisions.decision: Kept W12-100 OUTBOX provider support, added W13-10 provider mode, authorization, staging proof, budget, and timeout keys, and preserved production fail-closed guards.

collisions.finding: W12-100 provider transport used explicit environment, allowlist, canary, and receipt-cache gates while W13-10 added a provider activation policy and attempt idempotency.
collisions.decision: Composed both layers: hard transport/environment/idempotency gates run first, W13 activation policy runs before adapter invocation, accepted receipts remain cached, and retry classification accepts both legacy and W13 blocker codes.

collisions.finding: W12-100 public signup markup and legal-document renderer conflicted with W13-10 hidden consent fields and separate notice renderer.
collisions.decision: Kept W12-100 visible channel-specific signup controls, added W13-10 consent_context payload, generated /communications-consent and /student-data through the shared legal-document renderer, and surfaced counsel_review_required in legal metadata.

collisions.finding: Provider tests disagreed on blocker vocabulary and idempotency key shape; public consent tests disagreed with the merged DOM.
collisions.decision: Updated expectations to W13 activation blocker vocabulary and attempt-scoped provider keys while preserving no-repeat provider calls for cached accepted receipts; public tests now assert merged visible labels and legal routes.

collisions.finding: The W12-09 branch carried useful gamification work but was based on an older release/ops10 line and would delete W12-100/W13 records and migrations if mechanically merged.
collisions.decision: Skipped mechanical merge; ported only safe W12-09 gamification semantics onto the W13-100 branch.

collisions.finding: W12-09 introduced migration prefix 2200 after W12-100 already occupied later migration space.
collisions.decision: Rebased the gamification schema into additive migration 2203 and verified no duplicate migration prefixes across 39 migration files.

collisions.finding: W12-09 added strict gamification summaries beside existing portal rewards/progress and existing portal-test-lab reward reasons.
collisions.decision: Made gamification optional in portal dashboards, preserved existing progress/reward fields, injected a portal gamification adapter, and filtered legacy reward reasons out of the strict gamification reason-code summary.

collisions.area: visible actions and owner app route composition
collisions.finding: W12-09 introduced owner/admin reward administration and parent reward-goal creation that needed visible-action and route coverage.
collisions.decision: Added /app/rewards, rewards refresh/open actions, and parent reward-goal form registry entries without changing existing owner routes.

collisions.finding: Merged gamification text created strict-selector collisions for generic progress labels; legal pages exposed multiple counsel-review metadata markers.
collisions.decision: Scoped the portal test to exact metric cells and the legal test to the first visible main-region counsel marker while leaving product behavior unchanged.
